a.description: N-dimensional array. ``a.shape[axisa]`` indicates the dimension of the cross product, and must be 2 or 3.

b.description: N-dimensional array. Must have ``b.shape[axisb] == a.shape[axisb]``, and other dimensions of ``a`` and ``b`` must be broadcast compatible.

axisa.description: specicy the axis of ``a`` along which to compute the cross product.

axisb.description: specicy the axis of ``b`` along which to compute the cross product.

axisc.description: specicy the axis of ``c`` along which the cross product result will be stored.

axis.description: if specified, this overrides ``axisa``, ``axisb``, and ``axisc`` with a single value.

output.description: The array ``c`` containing the (batched) cross product of ``a`` and ``b`` along the specified axes.
